name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 3 visits over 23 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 28 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 23 hours starting 2025-10-31, at wavelengths from 1.64 to 5.00 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
